text: This week the design team finished the new onboarding screens and handed them to engineering on Wednesday. Testing with five customers showed that most people found the account setup much clearer than before, although two of them still missed the button that skips the tutorial. We will make that button larger and move it to the top right corner. The next review is planned for 18 November, and Laura will share the updated prototype with everyone two days before that.

Dear Mr Patel, I am writing about the leak under the kitchen sink in flat 4B. It started three weeks ago and the cupboard floor is now soft and smells of damp. I reported it by phone on 2 October but nobody has come to look at it yet. Could you please arrange for a plumber to visit this week? I am at home every morning before 11 and can also leave a key with the neighbour in 4C. Thank you for your help.

To make the lentil soup, soften one chopped onion and two carrots in a little olive oil for about ten minutes. Add a teaspoon of cumin, a pinch of chilli and two crushed garlic cloves, and stir for a minute until they smell fragrant. Pour in 250 grams of red lentils and a litre of vegetable stock, then simmer for twenty minutes until the lentils fall apart. Blend half of the soup, season it with salt and lemon juice, and serve it with warm bread.

Year 6 will visit the Science Museum on Friday 7 March. The coach leaves the school gate at 8.30 and returns at about 4 o'clock. Every child needs a packed lunch in a disposable bag, a water bottle and a coat, because part of the day is outside. The trip costs 12 pounds, which can be paid through the parent app until 28 February. Please tell the class teacher about any allergies or medicine your child needs to take during the day.

I'm really sorry that I missed your birthday dinner on Saturday. My train from Leeds was cancelled and the replacement bus took almost three hours, so by the time I got back it was nearly midnight. I know you had booked the table weeks ago and I feel terrible about letting you down. Can I take you out for lunch next weekend instead? I'd like to make it up to you, and I still have your present waiting here.

The Kestrel 2 backpack holds a laptop of up to 16 inches in a padded sleeve that opens from the side, so you can take the computer out without unpacking everything else. The outer fabric is made from recycled bottles and keeps light rain out. There are two side pockets for water bottles, a hidden pocket for a passport, and a strap that slides over the handle of a suitcase. It weighs 900 grams and comes in grey, navy and olive.

In today's meeting we agreed to move the website launch from 3 June to 17 June, because the payment page still fails on some older phones. Omar will fix the payment bug by the end of next week. Grace will rewrite the help pages and send them to legal for a check. Marketing will hold the launch emails until the new date is confirmed. We also decided to stop the weekly status call and use a shared document instead.

I would like to apply for the position of junior data analyst that was advertised on your website. Over the last two years I have worked as an intern at a small logistics company, where I cleaned delivery data, built weekly reports in spreadsheets and learned to write basic SQL queries. I enjoy finding patterns that help people make better decisions. I graduated in mathematics from the University of Bristol in 2024 and I am available to start in January.

The tomatoes did well this summer, but the courgettes got powdery mildew in August and stopped producing. Next year I want to plant them further apart so the air can move between the leaves, and water the soil instead of the plants. The beans grew so tall that they fell over in the wind, so I need stronger canes. I also want to try growing garlic, which apparently goes in the ground in October and is ready the following July.

On Sunday 12 May between 9 pm and midnight, the email system will be unavailable while we move it to new servers. Messages sent to you during that time will not be lost; they will arrive once the move is finished. You do not need to do anything, but please save any drafts before 9 pm. If you still cannot sign in on Monday morning, restart your computer first and then call the help desk on extension 4400.

We land in Lisbon at 2 in the afternoon and pick up the hire car at the airport. The first two nights are in a guest house near the castle, then we drive south to the coast for four days of swimming and walking. On the way back we want to stop in Évora to see the old Roman temple. The flight home leaves at 7 in the evening on the 21st, so we need to return the car by 5.

I ordered a washing machine from your store on 5 September and paid extra for delivery and installation. The machine arrived a week late, and the driver said he was not allowed to install it, so it is still standing in my hallway. Since then I have called customer service four times and each time I was promised a callback that never came. I would like the installation done within seven days or a refund of the 60 pound installation fee.

Thank you to everyone who helped at the river clean-up on Saturday. Thirty-two volunteers turned up, which is our biggest group so far, and together we pulled out more than forty bags of rubbish, two shopping trolleys and an old bicycle. The council has agreed to collect everything on Tuesday. Our next clean-up will be at the park lake on 9 November, and we will provide gloves, grabbers and hot drinks.

Your appointment with Dr Okafor is confirmed for Thursday 14 April at 10.15 at the Riverside Health Centre. Please arrive ten minutes early and bring a list of the medicines you take. The appointment will last about twenty minutes. If you cannot come, please cancel at least 24 hours before so that another patient can use the time. Parking is limited, so we suggest taking the number 22 bus, which stops outside the centre.

The novel follows a lighthouse keeper on a small Scottish island who finds a stranger washed up on the rocks after a storm. For the first half the story moves slowly, with long descriptions of the weather and the sea, and I nearly gave up. The second half is much stronger: the stranger's past slowly comes out, and the ending surprised me completely. I would recommend it to patient readers who enjoy quiet books with a strong sense of place.

The removal van is booked for 8 o'clock on Friday, so everything needs to be packed by Thursday night. Kitchen boxes should be labelled clearly, and anything fragile should go in the car with us rather than in the van. The new flat has no curtains yet, so we will need to bring the bedroom blinds from here. Remember to read the electricity and water meters before we leave and to send the photos to the landlord.

For the next six weeks I want to run three times a week: an easy thirty minutes on Monday, intervals on Wednesday and a longer run on Saturday morning. The aim is to finish the 10 kilometre race on 30 June in under an hour. I will add a short stretching routine after each run, because my knee hurt last time I trained this hard. If the knee pain comes back, I will swap one run for a swim.

Thank you for contacting us about the missing charger for your headphones. I am sorry that it was not in the box. I have arranged for a new charger to be sent to you free of charge, and it should arrive within three working days. You do not need to return anything. Your reference number is 58213 in case you need to contact us again. We hope you enjoy the headphones.

The bridge was built in 1889 to replace a ferry that had carried people across the river for more than two hundred years. At the time it was one of the longest iron bridges in the country, and thousands of people came to watch the opening. It was closed to cars in 1972 after cracks were found in two of its supports. Today it is open only to walkers and cyclists, and it is lit up in blue every evening.

Hi, I live at number 14 and I just wanted to let you know that we are having a small party for my son's eighteenth birthday on Saturday evening. There will be about twenty people, mostly in the garden, and the music will be off by 11 pm. If anything bothers you on the night, please just knock on the door or text me on the number below. Sorry in advance for any noise, and thanks for being such good neighbours.

We surveyed 400 people who work from home at least three days a week. Most of them said they were more productive at home, but almost half also reported feeling lonely, especially those who live alone. People who had a regular video call with their team said they felt less isolated than those who only used chat. Younger workers were more likely than older workers to want to return to the office for part of the week.

You are invited to Maya and Ben's wedding on Saturday 23 August at Hillside Farm. The ceremony starts at 2 pm in the orchard, followed by dinner and dancing in the barn. Please let us know by 1 July whether you can come and whether you have any food allergies. There is free parking at the farm, and a minibus will run back to the station at 11 pm and at midnight.

When I open a large photo in the editor and press the crop button, the app freezes for about ten seconds and then closes without saving. This happens every time with pictures over about 20 megabytes, but smaller pictures work fine. I am using version 3.2 on a laptop with 8 gigabytes of memory. Before the last update, cropping the same pictures worked without any problem, so I think the update caused it.

The chess club will now meet on Tuesday evenings instead of Thursdays, starting next month, because the library needs the room on Thursdays. We are also starting a beginners' group at 6 pm before the main session, run by Sofia, who won the regional junior title last year. New members are welcome at any time, and the yearly fee is still 20 pounds. Boards and clocks are provided, but bring your own if you have them.

I would like to request annual leave from Monday 4 August to Friday 15 August. I have checked with the rest of the team and Priya has agreed to cover my client calls while I am away. Before I leave I will finish the quarterly report and hand over the two open support cases. I will still have four days of leave left after this for the end of the year.

The forecast says heavy rain will arrive on Saturday afternoon and last until Sunday morning, with strong winds near the coast. Because of that we are moving the outdoor market from Saturday to Sunday, opening at noon once the rain has passed. Stallholders should arrive by 10 to set up. If the wind is still too strong on Sunday, we will cancel and give everyone a full refund of their pitch fee.

If your printer shows as offline, first check that it is switched on and connected to the same Wi-Fi network as your computer. Then remove it from the list of printers in Settings and add it again, which often fixes the connection. If that does not work, restart the router and wait two minutes before trying once more. Printers older than about ten years may need a cable, because they do not support newer wireless security.

Thank you so much for looking after Biscuit while we were in Spain. He clearly had a wonderful time, because he has been sulking ever since we brought him home. The garden also looks better than when we left, and we really appreciated the fresh milk and bread in the fridge when we got back late on Sunday. Please let us know when you next go away so we can return the favour.

Our household spending went up by about 150 pounds a month this year, mostly because of higher energy bills and food prices. To balance it, we plan to cancel two streaming services we hardly use, cook at home on weekdays and take packed lunches to work. We will also switch to a cheaper phone contract in March, when the current one ends. If we stick to this, we should save around 120 pounds a month.

Last month our library started lending more than just books. People can now borrow a sewing machine, a set of camping gear, a telescope, board games and even a small electric drill, all with the same card they use for novels. The idea came from a survey in which many residents said they owned tools they had used only once, and others said they could not afford to buy things they needed only for a weekend. So far the most popular items are the drill and the camping gear, which are booked every weekend until the end of the summer. Staff check each item when it comes back and clean it before it goes out again. If the scheme keeps going well, the library hopes to add a pressure washer and a projector next year, and it is asking local businesses to donate equipment they no longer need at home.
